q.g: In this quest you have to kill 40 any targets from less than 60 meters away on The Lab while wearing a Respirator, a GP-5 gas mask, a GP-7 gas mask, a Gentex Ops-Core SOTR respirator, or an Avon M53A1 gas mask. Bug: Kills with the MSA Millennium Riot Control Gasmask doesn't count for this quest.
